== Notes ==
* Though not stated in the description, this skill's projectile actually moves faster than normal.
* If this skill hits a moving target, its additional damage is dealt in a separate [[packet]].
* Provided that the prerequisites for additional damage of the skills are met, [[Lightning Hammer]], [[Lightning Orb]], and [[Mind Shock]] deal the same amount of damage from Air Magic rank 14 to 16.
{{bug|[["Master of My Domain"]] considers each packet a separate skill.}}

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Lightning Bolt/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
* The projectile of this skill used to move at normal speed when it was introduced.
